policy.least_work_scope: work_delegation_gate direct-execution routing applies only to the separate gate-owned task queue; authoritative O revision 24 forbids applying revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O
policy.candidate_identity: Canonical source-qualified identity is mandatory. Never join by bare short candidate id, display label, prefix/suffix heuristic, or semantic/fuzzy alias.
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separate fields even when produced by one comparator run
policy.control_freshness: Every non-exploration invocation must resolve a fresh note main SHA after invocation start using a SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup, fetch DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE at that exact SHA, then repeat the SHA-only lookup immediately before the first substantive semantic read. If head or relevant control/config changed, refetch and restart presemantic bootstrap. Freeze the tuple after semantic work starts; semantic reads before the guard make bootstrap_valid=false and downstream output ineligible. Never use commit/search/branch semantic payload merely to resolve head.
policy.bootstrap_validity_contract: Audits and comparators must carry bootstrap_valid=true plus the frozen control tuple in durable receipts and downstream-consumable outputs. Integrator rejects or defers missing/false bootstrap provenance and recorded presemantic-order defects; historical artifacts remain provenance only.
policy.bridge_freshness: bridge pins feed to observed note main SHA, rechecks SHA-only head before mutation, refetches on head advance/revision regression, and never regresses tracked feed revision

o_feed_backlog_control.rule: Before admission while O clean cursor lags, compare against all unacknowledged feed items by source-qualified identity, mechanism, decision question, tested scope and uncertainty. Admit only material incremental decision information; preserve supersession provenance and never drop distinct decision-relevant items for an arbitrary cap.
o_feed_backlog_control.receipt_requirement: emit all metrics on every integrator run, including no-admission runs

downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: If no incomplete active wave exists, seal one source-qualified artifact/blob per clean namespace from latest valid role-local pointer/checkpoint; keep incomplete wave immutable.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: novelty/relevance and evidence evaluate exact ACTIVE_WAVE; no moving-latest substitution.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: Require a bootstrap-valid exact-wave final novelty/relevance pair whose persisted raw identity manifest passes independent readback and digest recomputation. Evidence may be a bootstrap-valid mechanically validated exact-identity subset; omitted candidates are evidence_status=not_assessed. Reject ambiguous/nonmember, schema-2 key/row disagreement, or persistence-invalid rows, then reconcile/readback/mark integrated and seal next wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE is downstream-only; clean explorers never read it.

policy.capacity_invariant: Repository enablement and platform execution are distinct. A repository-enabled role that is physically inactive consumes no active slot and must not be described as executing. automation_optimizer may execute at most one isolated gate-owned fallback task only while the physical gate is inactive, preserving gate ownership, idempotency, one-task limit and write isolation.

candidate_identity_contract.authoritative_identity_row: Persist exactly [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id]. These three stored values are the entire authoritative candidate identity. Do not persist a row-level canonical key as an independent authority field.
candidate_identity_contract.source_local_candidate_id: Exact candidate identifier from the sealed source artifact; display labels are separate non-key fields.
candidate_identity_contract.canonical_candidate_key: Pure derived value sha256(UTF8(compact_JSON(authoritative_identity_row,ensure_ascii=false))). Producers may report it as non-authoritative convenience metadata, but every consumer must recompute it from the exact parsed row and ignore disagreement.
candidate_identity_contract.candidate_set_digest: sha256 of UTF-8 compact JSON of the ordered persisted authoritative three-field identity rows with ensure_ascii=false
candidate_identity_contract.full_pair_manifest: Final novelty and relevance reference the identical immutable ordered three-field raw identity manifest and same assessment_count/candidate_set_digest. Semantic assessments bind to raw row index or exact raw tuple, not to a separately persisted key.
candidate_identity_contract.evidence_subset: Every evidence row carries the exact three-field authoritative identity tuple. Membership is exact tuple membership in the full-pair raw manifest. An optional declared key is convenience only and must be recomputed; omitted full-pair candidates are evidence_status=not_assessed.
candidate_identity_contract.recompute_boundary: Construct the current-wave raw tuple directly from the exact sealed source artifact/blob and local id. Never inherit a predecessor-wave key, tuple, digest, display label, or alias.
candidate_identity_contract.publication_self_audit: After writing the immutable raw identity manifest, refetch the exact persisted blob, parse every three-field row, require each row to have exactly three strings, recompute candidate_set_digest from the parsed stored rows, and compare count/digest to the final pair. Pair eligibility depends only on the parsed persisted raw rows and digest; an in-memory/pre-write audit is advisory only.
candidate_identity_contract.schema2_compatibility: Schema-2 four-field manifests remain historical provenance. If a stored key disagrees with sha256(row[0:3]), the artifact is integration-ineligible and must be identity-normalized to schema 3 without semantic reassessment; consumers must never repair by fuzzy aliasing.
candidate_identity_contract.normalization_reissue: For unchanged exact-wave semantics, publish an immutable schema-3 raw-identity reissue with semantic_reassessment=false, preserve predecessor/supersession provenance, validate exact persisted bytes, then converge both LATEST pointers only after readback.

pair_pointer_publication_contract.publication_complete_rule: A final exact-wave novelty/relevance pair is not publication-complete until both LATEST pointers converge after readback on the same current wave, active-wave blob, raw identity manifest blob, candidate_set_digest, assessment_count, and immutable novelty/relevance blobs.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.producer_repair_rule: After publishing or discovering an already-existing bootstrap-valid final pair for the unchanged exact wave, o_novelty_comparator must inspect both LATEST pointers. Stale/missing/mismatched pointers require bounded pointer-only repair with fresh pre-write head/CAS/readback; do not redo semantics.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.consumer_stale_pointer_rule: evidence_comparator must not infer final-pair absence solely from stale LATEST. If a bootstrap-valid current-wave comparator receipt or immutable exact-wave pair proves the pair exists, classify pair_artifacts_found_pointer_stale, stop new pre-pair semantic supplements, and use the exact raw identity manifest for mechanical membership normalization once safe.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.anti_duplication_rule: Once a bootstrap-valid final pair exists for the exact wave, further pre-pair evidence semantic expansion is forbidden unless that pair is invalidated by a concrete provenance/identity defect. Pointer repair and identity normalization are mechanical work.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.readback_requirement: Pointer repair is downstream-consumable only after both pointers are read back and mechanically match the immutable final pair; immutable semantic artifacts are never rewritten.

lossless_feed_publication_contract.purpose: Prevent repeated safe-but-unproductive feed deferral caused by truncated connector rendering when the exact current feed body is retrievable losslessly.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.lossless_input_rule: Before mutating O_FEED, fetch the exact current feed blob at the prewrite main and obtain its complete UTF-8 body. A truncated UI/tool rendering is not proof that the body is unavailable. If the connector exposes a raw/blob response, response resource URI, pagination, scrolling, or equivalent lossless read surface, consume it to completion and parse the complete JSON before deciding that a lossless rewrite is impossible.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.authority_rule: The exact parsed current feed blob is the only rewrite baseline. Never reconstruct prior acknowledged items from summaries, receipts, snippets, remembered text, index state, or candidate ids alone.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.retention_rule: Preserve every currently acknowledged feed item structurally unless the same invocation records an explicit source-qualified supersession/compaction allowed by backlog control. When o_cursor_revision equals feed_revision and active_unacknowledged_item_count is zero, prior acknowledged items remain retained history and must not be dropped merely to append new decisions.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.admission_rule: Admit only candidates already established by an exact bootstrap-valid wave triplet and the current backlog/incremental-decision policy. If a queued candidate lacks enough exact semantic fields for a lossless admission, defer that candidate only; do not treat that as inability to preserve the current feed body.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.write_rule: Build the full next feed object from the exact parsed baseline plus explicit supersessions/admissions, recompute all backlog metrics and the feed content digest from the final object, then perform a fresh prewrite main/blob CAS. Never perform a partial append, lossy rewrite, or write against a stale feed blob.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.readback_rule: Refetch the exact written feed blob, parse the entire JSON, recompute the canonical content digest, verify prior retained item identities/count, explicit supersessions, new admissions, revision monotonicity and O cursor/backlog metrics. Only then may publication be called durable.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.defer_rule: If complete current-body retrieval, exact candidate admission data, CAS, or full readback cannot be proven, defer without feed mutation and record the exact missing transport/data condition. Repeated direct-render truncation must trigger an alternate lossless read surface before repeating the same defer classification.

migration.reason: Two consecutive bootstrap-valid integrator config12 state-changing invocations (C21->C22 and C22->C23) independently validated schema3 integration but deferred O_FEED publication with the same lossless-full-body reason while O cursor already equaled feed revision 10. Optimizer reconciliation retrieved the exact revision-10 feed blob as complete parseable JSON through the response resource despite truncated direct rendering. Revision21 makes lossless whole-object retrieval/readback explicit so renderer truncation does not become an indefinite useful-output bottleneck.
migration.rollback: Restore downstream blob aa151ff897e280d58539e37b2edd337e9167e896 only if the lossless-feed contract prevents a valid integration/checkpoint because the role runtime exposes no lossless exact-blob read surface, or if it would require a lossy/partial feed rewrite. Preserve schema3 identity, bootstrap validity, durable exit receipts, CLEAN/O isolation, backlog metrics, and no-fuzzy-join on rollback.

durable_execution_receipt_contract.state_changing_downstream_rule: A downstream invocation that changes ACTIVE_WAVE, integration state, index/feed state, or another durable coordinator state must persist an immutable role receipt in its configured receipt_namespace before the invocation may be described as durably complete. The receipt must bind the frozen bootstrap tuple, exact wave/triplet inputs, state mutations, resulting commit/blob/readback identities, backlog metrics when applicable, termination and exact next action.
durable_execution_receipt_contract.receipt_gap_rule: If a durable state transition exists without its corresponding immutable receipt, preserve the already-read-back transition as execution evidence but classify receipt_gap=true. Do not rewrite or roll back a valid integrated wave solely to manufacture a receipt. Before the role's next state-changing transition, reconstruct a mechanical gap diagnostic from immutable integration/index/ACTIVE_WAVE artifacts and then require the next invocation to satisfy the receipt barrier.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic freshness guard before any clean/public semantic read. Invalid guard => diagnostic only. Otherwise verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact source-qualified scope and no worker steering; rotate under-audited namespaces; separate unverified from contradicted; carry frozen tuple.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic guard before clean/audit/repository/public semantic reads. Invalid guard => diagnostic only. Audit implementation/reproduction evidence for high-value clean candidates, prioritizing exact ACTIVE_WAVE/feed when useful; distinguish claim, official support, independent reproduction/failure, missing dependencies/config and O-specific adaptation; exact scope only; no explorer steering/feedback; carry frozen tuple.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Complete fresh two-check SHA-only presemantic guard. Evaluate the exact sealed wave and publish novelty plus decision relevance as one immutable bootstrap-valid pair under candidate_identity_contract schema 3. Persist a separate immutable raw identity manifest containing only exact [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id] rows; never persist a row-level canonical key as authority. Refetch/parse that exact blob, require exactly three strings per row, recompute candidate_set_digest from the parsed stored rows, and bind both semantic outputs and LATEST pointers to the raw manifest blob/count/digest. Identity-only normalization for unchanged semantics must use semantic_reassessment=false. Never modify O or explorer feedback.

evidence_comparator.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic guard. Assess exact sealed-wave evidence selectively. Bind every downstream-eligible evidence row to the exact three-field raw identity tuple from the final pair; membership is exact tuple membership in the persisted schema-3 raw manifest. Any declared canonical key is non-authoritative convenience and must be recomputed from the raw tuple. Omitted pair candidates get no inference. Never fuzzy-map aliases, rewrite semantic artifacts in place, or write explorer judgments.

integrator.receipt_gap_recovery: Before the next state-changing integration after observing a missing prior receipt, emit or persist a mechanical gap diagnostic that binds the prior immutable integration artifact and current coordinator state; never mutate the already-valid prior integration solely to fill observability.
integrator.policy: Complete presemantic freshness guard. Sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator; keep incomplete wave immutable. For schema 3, fetch and parse the exact persisted raw identity manifest, independently recompute candidate_set_digest, require novelty/relevance raw-manifest/count/digest equality, derive keys only from raw tuples, and accept evidence only as an exact tuple subset; no fuzzy joins and omitted candidates are not_assessed. On validation failure defer without integrating/resealing. Otherwise preserve contradictions/scope/provenance/uncertainty, apply only source-matched bootstrap-valid audits, enforce backlog control, read back exact outputs, then seal next wave. DURABLE EXIT BARRIER: every bootstrap-valid invocation, especially any integration/reseal/index/feed mutation or no-change decision after reading a complete triplet, must persist an immutable own receipt before reporting durable completion. LOSSLESS O_FEED PUBLICATION: when non-rejected or materially incremental decisions are ready, apply policy.lossless_feed_publication_contract. Direct rendering truncation is not itself a defer reason if an exact blob/raw/scrollable response resource can provide the complete feed body. Preserve every acknowledged baseline item except explicit source-qualified supersessions, admit only exact current-triplet decisions, CAS the whole object, recompute digest, and verify full readback. If complete exact feed body or exact admission data truly cannot be obtained, defer safely with the specific missing condition; never perform a partial/lossy rewrite.

bridge.policy: Bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling, no individual item spam, preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement and CAS/readback. Fresh O owner suppresses recovery/duplicate writing; never import work_delegation_gate policy into primary O; use SHA-only control/feed freshness and never regress feed revision.

work_delegation_gate.policy: ACTIVE BOUNDED SUPPORT. Freeze fresh root/downstream/config then execute exactly one highest-priority uncompleted gate-owned task. Direct reasoning/tools/APIs/automations/repository first; Work only if task explicitly allows and remains separate from primary O. Never export old least-Work policy to primary O, become a second O writer, or interrupt frozen O. Gate-local writes only with CAS/idempotency. Empty queue => one bounded nonduplicative optimizer maintenance/integrity unit, not logical no-op. Optimizer fallback is allowed only while physical gate inactive and saturated; fail closed on stale control/authority collision/duplicate key/cross-role write.

automation_optimizer.policy: Optimize managed repo-defined behavior from actual durable execution evidence; sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable. Preserve CLEAN independence, exact scope, O single-writer/fence/CAS, wave immutability, backlog control and gate isolation. Distinguish physical from logical capacity. Detect stale bootstrap, contamination, duplication, stalls, candidate-identity defects, stale downstream pointers and repeated feed-publication deferral. Raw persisted three-field source tuples are candidate identity authority and canonical keys are derived only. For feed publication, treat truncated rendering as a presentation constraint and require an exact lossless whole-object fetch/readback path before declaring the feed body unavailable. Reallocate physical capacity only from measured marginal value.
